info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Plans-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Plans API provides access to a comprehensive list of available utility billing plans for consumers. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about each plan, including pricing, features, and eligibility criteria. Ideal for utility providers and developers, the API facilitates integration with customer management systems and enhances the user experience for customers selecting a suitable billing option. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve their customer engagement and streamline their billing processes.

get.description: Fetches the details of the current billing plan for the account, providing necessary information about subscription level, features, and pricing.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the billing plan details. This JSON payload should conform to the expected schema for the operation.

ListUtilityBillingPlansRequest.description: This schema represents the request body sent when performing a GET operation related to billing plans.
